text:
Explain the distinction carefully. Historical recurrence records how often cells burned in the 2016–2025 evidence window, using a 2 km context. Structural hazard is an official ICNF classification of persistent landscape hazard conditions, aggregated from 25 m classes to the predominant 1 km class. The comparison is descriptive context, not a model accuracy test.

[Sources]

text:
Introduce the transparent historical recurrence baseline and the nine-feature hurdle model. The baseline maps prior recurrence to expected next-year burned share. The hurdle model uses a first component for whether burning occurs and a second component for positive burned share. The table reports the frozen final temporal comparison. Capture@20% asks how much observed burned share lies among the 20% highest-ranked cells; it is only a technical ranking diagnostic.

[Sources]
